title: Add a configuration loader that reads, parses and validates
expectation: Without guidance the agent splits the loader by step into readConfig, parseConfig and validateConfig modules that each know the file format.
prompt: Add configuration loading: read config.json from the working directory (JSON), apply defaults for anything missing, validate that port is an integer from 1 to 65535, host is a non-empty string and logLevel is one of debug, info, warn or error, and make index.js start the server with the result. An invalid file must produce a clear error message. Add tests.
